scope: Visual ball referent selection plus bounded closed-loop navigation; single high-level action, not full GUI beam search.

reward.labels: single-token yes/no; action verification and physically measured completion/truncation

physical_cases: 走到画面左边的球旁边
走到画面右边的球旁边
走到画面左边的球旁边
走到画面左边的球旁边
test_policy: No test evaluation or test-guided tuning until actor/reward branches are trained; retain all failures.
compute_control: Equal actor optimization steps and optimizer resets; reward-model and exploration compute are additional and reported separately.
historical_exclusions: windows-vision-v1 has MSAA-contaminated segmentation boxes; retained for diagnostics only
vision-torch-smoke adapter is not used in any formal experiment

branch_protocol_frozen_before_exploratio.replay_mixture: Repeat new verified replay rows to approximately equal original train rows; report raw trajectories separately
branch_protocol_frozen_before_exploratio.actor_replay_requires: Independent physical/semantic verification AND learned reward >= 0.5
